FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'le père' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the girl
   B. the family
   C. the father
   D. the grandfather

2. What does 'la chambre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the book
   B. the fridge
   C. the bedroom
   D. the cat

3. What number is 'quatorze' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 13
   C. 18
   D. 2

4. What number is 'trente' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 3
   C. 10
   D. 13

5. How do you say 'I sing and I dance.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai dix ans.
   B. Bon anniversaire !
   C. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   D. Je chante et je danse.

6. What does 'la mangue' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. the mango
   C. the orange
   D. the tomato

7. What does 'le genou' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the stomach
   B. the knee
   C. the finger
   D. the ear

8. What does 'la jambe' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the eyes
   B. the stomach
   C. the leg
   D. the hand

9. Fill in: J'ai ______ mains. (2) (1 mark)
   A. trois
   B. deux
   C. un
   D. dix

10. What does 'l'orage' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the storm
   B. the cloud
   C. the weather
   D. the sun

11. What does 'agréable' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. pleasant
   B. the cloud
   C. strong
   D. the rain

12. What does 'à côté de' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to the left
   B. next to
   C. to the right
   D. straight ahead

13. How do you say 'Turn right.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Où est la clé ?
   B. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   C. Elle est sous la chaise.
   D. Tournez à droite.

14. Which little word goes with 'père' (the father)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. la
   D. le

15. What does 'Mon père s'appelle David.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my sister.
   B. My mother is called Grace.
   C. My father is called David.
   D. Who is it?

16. What does 'Voici mon grand-père.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my grandfather.
   B. My sister is called Njeri.
   C. Here is my grandmother.
   D. This is my sister.

17. What does 'Le ballon est derrière la porte.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The bag is in the bedroom.
   B. It is a bed.
   C. The ball is behind the door.
   D. Put the book on the table.

18. What does 'Une semaine, sept jours.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   B. A week, seven days.
   C. On Saturday, I play.
   D. What day is it today?

19. Read: Aujourd'hui, c'est le 12 mai. C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina. Elle a dix ans. Il y a un gâteau et dix bougies. Question: What is the date? (1 mark)
   A. 12 May
   B. 10 May
   C. 12 March
   D. 2 May

20. What does 'C'est un gâteau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   B. I like milk.
   C. I do not like fish.
   D. It is a cake.

21. What does 'C'est une banane.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat a mango.
   B. It is a banana.
   C. What is it?
   D. I drink a juice.

22. Which little word goes with 'tomate' (the tomato)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. la
   D. l'

23. Which little word goes with 'ventre' (the stomach)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. les
   D. la

24. Which little word goes with 'jardin' (the garden)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. la

25. What does 'Le lit est dans la chambre.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The cat is behind the door.
   B. You are welcome!
   C. The bed is in the bedroom.
   D. Turn right.

26. What does 'Le chat est derrière la porte.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The cat is behind the door.
   B. It is under the chair.
   C. The door is next to the window.
   D. Where is the key?

27. How do you say 'Pleased to meet you' in French? (1 mark)
   A. bien
   B. Enchanté
   C. merci
   D. bonjour

28. Which word needs a capital letter in a French sentence? (1 mark)
   A. Amina
   B. salut in the middle of a sentence
   C. bonjour in the middle of a sentence
   D. merci in the middle of a sentence

29. How do you say 'the sister' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le frère
   B. la sœur
   C. la famille
   D. le père

30. How do you say 'the table' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la table
   B. la salle de bain
   C. la télé
   D. la cuisine

31. How do you say 'between' in French? (1 mark)
   A. sur
   B. derrière
   C. entre
   D. dans

32. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'behind'? (1 mark)
   A. derière
   B. derrière
   C. derriére
   D. derriere

33. How do you say 'the school' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jour
   B. l'école
   C. la semaine
   D. l'église

34. How do you say 'I play' in French? (1 mark)
   A. je joue
   B. je me repose
   C. demain
   D. je chante

35. How do you write the number 18 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-huit
   B. deux
   C. trente et un
   D. douze

36. How do you say 'black' in French? (1 mark)
   A. long
   B. noir
   C. grand
   D. court

37. How do you say 'the finger' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le cou
   B. la jambe
   C. le doigt
   D. l'épaule

38. How do you say 'the hand' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le ventre
   B. l'épaule
   C. le genou
   D. la main

39. How do you say 'a flood' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la neige
   B. une inondation
   C. le vent
   D. l'orage

40. Fill in: Le chat est ______ la table. (under) (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. dans
   C. sur
   D. devant

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: 'Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'It is windy.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Mets le livre sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Le chat est sous la chaise.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Tu as quel âge ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'J'ai dix ans.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Oui, ça va.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'Put the book in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Translate into English: 'Voici ma grand-mère.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'The book is on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Write the French words for: Put, behind, under (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Translate into English: 'Mon père s'appelle David.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into French: 'My name is Njeri.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

54. Write a short text of three sentences in French about your week. (4 marks) (4 marks)

55. Translate into French: 'My birthday is on 12 May.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Write the French words for: Pleased to meet you, Mrs, Madam, thank you (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into French: 'It is a bed.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Translate into French: 'I have two eyes.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

59. Translate into English: 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'I have two ears.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Translate into French: 'What is it?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

62. Translate into French: 'I do not like fish.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

SECTION A

1. C — the father
   le père means the father.

   la chambre means the bedroom.

3. A — 14

4. A — 30
   trente means 30.

5. D — Je chante et je danse.

6. B — the mango
   la mangue means the mango.

7. B — the knee
   le genou means the knee.

8. C — the leg
   la jambe means the leg.

   Two hands is deux mains.

12. B — next to
   à côté de means next to.

   Turn right. in French is Tournez à droite.

   père is masculine, so we say le père.

37. C — le doigt

38. D — la main
   the hand in French is la main.

39. B — une inondation
   a flood in French is une inondation.

40. A — sous
   Sous means under.
